# Source and representation fixtures

The office HTML fixtures are synthetic publisher-layout samples. The CSV
files are independent reference outputs for those samples and the synthetic
JSON and workbook recipes in tests/integration/universal_core/source_fixtures.py.
They establish byte parity with the reference extraction rules and contain
no live responses, credentials or unpublished data. The 1-YUR fixtures cover
all five mapping epochs, including a BIFF workbook in epoch A.
